title: The absent Achilles; Athena invokes Tydeus
intro: Hera shames the Greeks; Athena confronts Diomedes and invokes his father's example.

notes.text: εἴδομαι, assume the likeness of: aor mid ptc nom fem sg + dat; Stentor supplies Hera's voice.
μεγαλήτωρ, great-hearted; χαλκεόφωνος, bronze-voiced: dat sg.
αὐδάω, shout / speak: iterative aor αὐδήσασκε, “would shout”; κ → χ before rough breathing. As loud as fifty men.
“Shame!”; ἔλεγχος, disgrace / reproach: neut pl used as insult, “wretched disgraces.”
“Admirable in appearance”; εἶδος acc of respect; ἀγητός, admirable. Good looks contrasted with weak performance.
“As long as [Achilles] used to go”; πωλέομαι, go about / frequent: iterative impf mid.
“Used to venture outside the gates”; πύλη gen pl -άων; οἰχνέω, go: iterative impf, negated.
δείδω, fear: epic 3pl plup with impf sense; ὄβριμος, mighty / formidable.
ἑκάς + gen, far from; πόλις epic gen sg. κοῖλος, hollow; ναῦς dat pl, at the ships.
ὀτρύνω, rouse / urge: unaugmented 3sg impf; μένος καὶ θυμόν, strength and spirit.
ἐπορούω, spring / hasten towards: 3sg aor; + dat Τυδεΐδῃ.
ἄναξ, lord: acc sg. ὄχεα, chariot, epic -φι(ν) form functioning as dat after παρά.
ἕλκος, wound (neut); ἀναψύχω, cool / refresh: pres ptc acc sg with Diomedes.
“Where Pandarus struck him with an arrow”; τό refers to the wound / wounded spot; ἰός, arrow: dat sg.
ἱδρώς, sweat (nom sg); τείρω, wear down / chafe: 3sg impf.
πλατύς, broad: gen sg; τελαμών, shoulder-strap; εὔκυκλος, well-rounded, with shield.
τῷ, “by this [sweat / chafing].” τείρω impf pass, “was distressed”; κάμνω impf, “was weary in the arm,” acc of respect.
ἀνά + ἴσχω, hold up: pres ptc; lifting the shield strap to relieve pressure.
κελαινεφής, dark / black-clouded: acc neut sg with blood. ἀπομόργνυμι, wipe away: unaugmented 3sg impf.
ἅπτομαι, touch: 3sg aor mid + gen; ζυγόν, yoke; ἵππειος, of horses.
“Little like himself”; ἔοικα perf act ptc acc sg + dat οἷ. ὀλίγον adv., to a small degree.
γείνομαι, beget: unaugmented 3sg aor mid; subject Tydeus, object παῖδα.
ἔην = ἦν; δέμας, build / stature, acc of respect. Small in body, but a fighter.
ἐάω, allow: 1sg iterative impf, negated; Athena recalls forbidding combat.
ἐκπαιφάσσω, rush out aggressively / bluster: pres act inf.
νόσφιν + gen, apart from [the Greeks]; ἄγγελος, messenger / envoy. Καδμείωνες, Cadmeans, the Thebans.
δαίνυμι pres mid inf, feast; ἄνωγα, command: 1sg past here; ἕκηλος, at ease, acc sg with μιν.
ὅν possessive, “his own”; τὸ πάρος περ, “just as before,” adverbial phrase.
κοῦρος, young man: acc pl. προκαλίζομαι, challenge: unaugmented 3sg impf mid.
νικάω, win: 3sg impf; πάντα adv., “in everything”; ῥηϊδίως, easily (Attic ῥᾳδίως).
ἐπιτάρροθος, helper / supporter; ἦα, epic 1sg impf of εἰμί.
“I stand beside you”; προφρονέως, eagerly / with goodwill; κέλομαι, urge / command, + inf μάχεσθαι.
κάματος, weariness; πολυᾶϊξ, impetuous / much-rushing, here the exhaustion of strenuous activity.
γυῖον, limb: acc pl; δύω, enter: 3sg perf act, “has entered your limbs.” σευ = σου; fatigue is the subject.
